visualReview.notes: Principal connected Nymphenburg Palace exterior: pale central Baroque pavilion with tall round-headed central windows, crossed casements/mezzanine panes, pilasters/cornices and original blank medallion fields/ochre accents; stepped side pavilions, lower galleries and red ceramic hip roofs with dormers/stacks. Both pairs of outer ranges retain their four mapped open courts. Two mapped bridge galleries retain lower passages between reconstructed piers. Real main east door recess/curved soffit/raised threshold and short treads; west stone terrace with closed balustrade. Corrected ownership, thin leftover walls, entrance trim and southern gallery clearance within one author/inspect/fix pass.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Six textured roles use five existing256px shared graphs: plaster_lime, stone_limestone_raw, tile_ceramic, storefront and metal_painted. Neutral tile graph tinted red; painted metal supplies restrained ochre/dark accents. No embedded images/new graph/private atlas. One skyline draw, at most five textured draws, separate POSITION/NORMAL streams and equal CPU/GPU accounting. Each textured native run reads each graph once; all unloads release geometry.

fidelityReview.notes: Photo-led approximate exterior. Mapped unqualified height tags8/11/17m are working eave controls: central pavilion17m, inner pavilions11m, gallery/outer ranges8m, with distance-to-eave red hip roofs at slope0.65/rise capped10m. Most heights, roof junctions, bay/window/dormer/chimney inventories and unseen elevations are reconstructed, not surveyed. Two bridge tags lack reliable minimum height; a4m northern/8m southern gallery base (the southern8m base retains about2.8m clearance over the highest retained approach grade),11m working southern eave and four supporting pier rows per bridge are explicit schematic reconstruction. Main entrance0.5m above working floor has1.35m recess, arched soffit and five short treads. Western0.5m terrace/blank balustrade and original ochre accents abstract the photographed architecture without copying portrait medallions or arms. Qualified approximate medium-fi exterior fit. Boundary grades-2.655..+5.484m leave low-side foundations/uphill base and lower-window burial in outer ranges. Main entrance and both gallery crossings remain exposed in the inspected native views. Exact historic heights, floor connections, inventories, hidden elevations/roof junctions, paving/terrace/stair grades and accessibility are unverified. No furnished rooms, copied portraits/heraldic relief/inscriptions, garden/fountain sculpture or detached crescent/garden-pavilion models. Physical laptop/phone and dense-city timings remain pending.

frameReview.method: Actually inspected52 current frames in labeled contact sheets plus native main pavilion, court ranges, entrance and raised gallery passage at full resolution. Two ordinary pictures and standard PMTiles/Mapzen guided one author/inspect/fix pass. Corrected the exact parent/part ownership union, cleared thin remnant gallery walls caused by snapping boolean intersections, removed a facade course crossing the entrance and raised the inferred southern gallery to retain clearance over the original approach grade. No bespoke terrain research.
